title: Password Construction Standard
definition: Use a minimum of 16 characters in all work-related passwords.

title: Password Construction Standard
definition: Use of passphrases—passwords made up of multiple words—is encouraged.

title: Password Construction Standard
definition: The Infosec Team or its delegates may periodically or randomly attempt to crack or guess passwords.

title: Password Construction Standard
definition: Users must change any password guessed or cracked during a password scan.
